text_en: But the Lord will have compassion on Jacob and will again choose Israel, and will set them in their own land; and aliens will join them and attach themselves to the house of Jacob.
text_cn: 上主必要怜恤雅各伯，再拣选以色列，使他们安居在自己的国土；外方人要与他们联合，加入雅各伯的家族。

text_en: And the nations will take them and bring them to their place, and the house of Israel will possess the nations as male and female slaves in the Lord ’s land; they will take captive those who were their captors, and rule over those who oppressed them.
text_cn: 选民要接受他们，要带领他们回归故里；以色列家族，在上主的国土内，要占有他们为奴婢；于是以色列人要俘掳那俘掳过他们的人，要统治压迫他们的人。

text_en: When the Lord has given you rest from your pain and turmoil and the hard service with which you were made to serve,
text_cn: 当上主赐你摆脱困苦、忧患和你受的苦役时，那天，

text_en: you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has ceased! How his insolence has ceased!
text_cn: 你要对巴比伦王高唱这首讽刺诗说：怎么，暴虐者住手了！强横止息了！

text_en: The Lord has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of rulers,
text_cn: 邪恶者的棍棒，统治者的权杖，已为上主折断，

text_en: that struck down the peoples in wrath with unceasing blows, that ruled the nations in anger with unrelenting persecution.
text_cn: 就是那怀着怒气，三番五次痛击过万民，在忿恨中以无情的残虐，蹂躏过万邦的棍棒。

text_en: The whole earth is at rest and quiet; they break forth into singing.
text_cn: 大地安谧（mì）宁静，人人兴高采烈；

text_en: The cypresses exult over you, the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you were laid low, no one comes to cut us down. ”
text_cn: 连松树和黎巴嫩的香柏也都因你而喜庆：“自从你仆倒后，再没有谁上我们这里来砍伐！”

text_en: Sheol beneath is stirred up to meet you when you come; it rouses the shades to greet you, all who were leaders of the earth; it raises from their thrones all who were kings of the nations.
text_cn: 地下的阴府为了你而激动，为欢迎你的来临；并为了你，唤醒幽魂及地上所有的贵卿，使列国的君王由自己的宝座上起立；

text_en: All of them will speak and say to you: “You too have become as weak as we! You have become like us! ”
text_cn: 众人都开口对你说：“连你也衰弱得和我们一样啊！你也与我们相同啊！”

text_en: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, and the sound of your harps; maggots are the bed beneath you, and worms are your covering.
text_cn: 你的豪华，你琴瑟的乐声，也堕入阴府；你下面铺的是蛆(qū)，上面盖的是虫。

text_en: How you are fallen from heaven, O Day Star, son of Dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, you who laid the nations low!
text_cn: 朝霞的儿子──晨星！你怎会从天坠下？倾覆万邦者！你怎么也被砍倒在地？

text_en: You said in your heart, “I will ascend to heaven; I will raise my throne above the stars of God; I will sit on the mount of assembly on the heights of Zaphon;
text_cn: 你心中曾说过：“我要直冲霄汉，高置我的御座在天主的星宿以上；我要坐在盛会的山上，极北之处；

text_en: I will ascend to the tops of the clouds, I will make myself like the Most High. ”
text_cn: 我要升越云表，与至高者相平衡！”

text_en: But you are brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the Pit.
text_cn: 然而，你却下到了阴府，深渊的极处。

text_en: Those who see you will stare at you, and ponder over you: “Is this the man who made the earth tremble, who shook kingdoms,
text_cn: 看见你的，必注视你，仔细端详你说：“这不是那使大地战栗，列国动荡，

text_en: who made the world like a desert and overthrew its cities, who would not let his prisoners go home? ”
text_cn: 化世界为荒野，摧毁城邑，不为俘囚开放监狱的人吗？”

text_en: All the kings of the nations lie in glory, each in his own tomb;
text_cn: 万邦的君王都在荣耀中安葬，各在自己的阴宅里；

text_en: but you are cast out, away from your grave, like loathsome carrion, clothed with the dead, those pierced by the sword, who go down to the stones of the Pit, like a corpse trampled underfoot.
text_cn: 但是你却被抛于坟外，像一个叫人厌恶的流产胎儿，为刀剑杀戮的死者所掩盖，有如遭践踏的死尸。连那些被抛在石坑里的，

text_en: You will not be joined with them in burial, because you have destroyed your land, you have killed your people. May the descendants of evildoers nevermore be named!
text_cn: 你也不得与他们一同埋葬，因为你破坏了你的国土，残杀了你的人民：恶人的后代永不为人所提念。

text_en: Prepare slaughter for his sons because of the guilt of their father. Let them never rise to possess the earth or cover the face of the world with cities.
text_cn: 你们应为他们的儿子准备屠场，因为他们的父亲有了罪孽；他们决不能再兴起，占据大地，而使地面满是荒凉。

text_en: I will rise up against them, says the Lord of hosts, and will cut off from Babylon name and remnant, offspring and posterity, says the Lord .
text_cn: 我要起来攻击他们──万军上主的断语──我要抹去巴比伦的名号、遗民、后裔和子孙──上主的断语。

text_en: And I will make it a possession of the hedgehog, and pools of water, and I will sweep it with the broom of destruction, says the Lord of hosts.
text_cn: 我要使她成为刺猬的领土和池沼，我以毁灭的扫帚(zhǒu)将她扫净──万军上主的断语。

text_en: The Lord of hosts has sworn: As I have designed, so shall it be; and as I have planned, so shall it come to pass:
text_cn: 万军的上主起誓说：“实在，我怎样想，必怎样实现；我怎样计划，必怎样成功：

text_en: I will break the Assyrian in my land, and on my mountains trample him under foot; his yoke shall be removed from them, and his burden from their shoulders.
text_cn: 我要在我的国土内粉碎亚述，在我的山岭上将她践踏；她的重担必要由他们肩上卸下。”

text_en: This is the plan that is planned concerning the whole earth; and this is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
text_cn: 这是对全地所决定的计划，这是向万邦所伸展的手臂，

text_en: For the Lord of hosts has planned, and who will annul it? His hand is stretched out, and who will turn it back?
text_cn: 因为万军的上主已决定，谁能阻止？他的手已伸出，谁能使它收回？

text_en: In the year that King Ahaz died this oracle came:
text_cn: 在阿哈次驾崩那年有以下这个神谕：

text_en: Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken, for from the root of the snake will come forth an adder, and its fruit will be a flying fiery serpent.
text_cn: “全体培肋舍特啊！你不要因为打击你的棍棒折断了就喜悦，因为由蛇的根子将生出毒蝮，而它的子息必是飞龙。”

text_en: The firstborn of the poor will graze, and the needy lie down in safety; but I will make your root die of famine, and your remnant I will kill.
text_cn: 贫苦的人在我的牧场上必得饲养，穷困的人要泰然安息；但是我要以饥荒饿死你的余生，杀绝你的遗民。

text_en: Wail, O gate; cry, O city; melt in fear, O Philistia, all of you! For smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in its ranks.
text_cn: 门啊！哀号吧！城啊！悲鸣吧！全体培肋舍特啊！战栗吧！因为有烟从北而来，在她的队伍中没有落伍者。”

text_en: What will one answer the messengers of the nation? “The Lord has founded Zion, and the needy among his people will find refuge in her. ”
text_cn: 然而要怎样答复外邦的使者？ “上主建立了熙雍，使他民族中的忧患者，在那里获得保护。”
